prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1356; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection involving a vehicle insured under your policy. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, in writing, or in person. If your insured or any other party is represented by counsel, please forward this letter to them and their counsel.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of the policy in force at the time of the accident, along with any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision and the claim. This includes, without limitation, photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data recorder information, recorded statements, adjuster notes, repair and total-loss records, and any surveillance or witness materials. Any destruction, alteration, or loss of such evidence may expose your company and your insured to sanctions. We look forward to your prompt written response.
